sections: 14.7.4.4 structural parent tree and next-key rules

observations: Exact Page.printToPDF point/inch/paper/scale/margin/template/totalPages and experimental generateTaggedPDF declarations; actual behavior bound to exact browser version/revision

decisions: Retain original public constructors and add immutable print snapshot rather than optional overload ambiguity
Validate resource-free print fragments before host creation; source content omitted from diagnostic text
Request tagging explicitly and validate page/element/parent-tree associations under the original context before returning a document
Keep structural association checks separate from complete PDF/UA semantics and human accessibility qualification
Retain actual physical page boxes, native final-page counters and independent reader differences
limitations: Complete print CSS/long-report/clipping and arbitrary HTML template/resource profiles remain mandatory
Full Form/object-reference/role/attribute/namespace structure profiles and independent PDF/UA plus semantic/human review remain mandatory
Deterministic qualified template fonts, complete actual RID/minimum/current/fallback runtimes and exact final packages remain mandatory
Full host isolation, resource/fuzz/visual/concurrency/endurance/performance gates remain mandatory
Browser Type3 font-matrix extraction and Poppler default table reading-order interoperability remain unqualified
